title: Retirement Portfolio & Pension Transfer Planning
subtitle: Structuring tax-efficient retirement annuities, pension transfers, and living annuities
author: Bouul Financial Team
problemHeadline: Outliving your retirement savings or paying unnecessary tax on pension drawdowns is a major risk
problemBody: Inflation and poor asset allocation erode purchasing power during retirement years.
bouulSolution: Certified Financial Planner (CFP) analyzes replacement ratios and tax-bracket optimization
Structuring living annuities, guaranteed annuities, and offshore asset diversification
Escrow released after delivery of signed Financial Planning Report and FAIS disclosure
aiPromptExample: Book financial advisor: 'Analyze current R4.2m pension fund for retirement at age 62.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Scope: Replacement Ratio Calculation + Living Annuity Drawdown Model (4.5%) + Tax Plan. Escrow: R4,500.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released upon client receipt of signed CFP advice record.
pirbStandard: FSCA (Financial Sector Conduct Authority) Registered FSP & CFP® Professional.

articleSections.heading: Tax-Free Lump Sum Drawdown

articleSections.heading: Sustainable Living Annuity Drawdowns

title: Estate Duty & Capital Gains Tax Optimization

author: Bouul Financial Team
problemHeadline: Up to 25% of an estate's value can be lost to Estate Duty, CGT, and executor fees upon death
problemBody: Heirs often face frozen assets or are forced to sell family property to pay estate taxes.

escrowGuarantee: Escrow released upon delivery of signed Estate Advice Record.
pirbStandard: FSCA Registered FSP & Fiduciary Institute SA Member.
